name: Risk Tolerance Assessment
description: Guides the user through a structured questionnaire to identify their investment risk tolerance based on time horizon, income stability, financial cushion, and emotional response to portfolio fluctuations. Produces a risk profile classification from conservative to aggressive. Use when the user asks about their risk tolerance, wants to assess how much investment risk they can handle, or needs a risk profile before building a portfolio allocation. Do NOT use for choosing specific investments (use portfolio-allocation-framework), understanding account types (use investment-account-types), or calculating retirement targets (use retirement-savings-calculator).
